results.description:
An Apple Books Classic edition.
From the playful parodies she wrote as a teenager to the polished novels that made her name, The Complete Works of Jane Austen gathers every stage of a writer blossoming into her genius. All six novels are here—Northanger Abbey, Sense and Sensibility, Pride and Prejudice, Mansfield Park, Emma, and Persuasion—along with the sly novella Lady Susan and the spirited, often hilarious comedy collected in Love and Friendship and Other Early Works. 

Together, they show Austen’s humor, empathy, and insight into human folly, all taking shape one story at a time. From youthful mischief to lasting wisdom, this is the full journey of Jane Austen—funny, observant, and endlessly attuned to the quirks of the heart.
